entries.literal: On bingshen, Zhen Prefecture reported that Military Governor Liu Zaiming had died.

entries.zh: 戊戌。
entries.en: On wuxu.
entries.literal: On wuxu.

entries.zh: 以河陽節度使武行德為鎮州節度使，以宣徽南院使李暉為河陽節度使，以相州節度使王繼宏為貝州節度使。
entries.en: Wu Xingde, military governor of Heyang, was appointed military governor of Zhen Prefecture; Li Hui, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made military governor of Heyang; and Wang Jihong, military governor of Xiang Prefecture, was transferred to military governor of Bei Prefecture.
entries.literal: Wu Xingde, military governor of Heyang, was appointed military governor of Zhen Prefecture; Li Hui, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was appointed military governor of Heyang; Wang Jihong, military governor of Xiang Prefecture, was appointed military governor of Bei Prefecture.

entries.zh: 壬寅，荊南高從誨入貢謝恩，釋罪。
entries.en: On renyin Gao Conghui of Jingnan came to court with tribute to express gratitude, and his crimes were pardoned.
entries.literal: On renyin, Gao Conghui of Jingnan came to pay tribute and express gratitude; his crimes were pardoned.

entries.zh: 丙午，以前永興軍節度使王守恩為西京留守。
entries.en: On bingwu Wang Shou'en, former military governor of the Yongxing Army, was appointed Western Capital garrison commander.
entries.literal: On bingwu, the former military governor of the Yongxing Army, Wang Shou'en, was appointed Western Capital garrison commander.

entries.zh: 是月，河北旱，青州蝗。
entries.en: That month Hebei suffered drought and Qing Prefecture had a locust plague.
entries.literal: That month, Hebei suffered drought and Qing Prefecture had locusts.

entries.zh: 秋七月戊申朔，相州節度使王繼宏殺節度判官張易，以訛言聞。
entries.en: On the first day of the seventh month in autumn, wushen, Wang Jihong, military governor of Xiang Prefecture, killed his adjutant Zhang Yi and reported the act on the grounds of a false rumor.
entries.literal: On the first day of the seventh month in autumn, wushen, Wang Jihong, military governor of Xiang Prefecture, killed his military commissioner's adjutant Zhang Yi, and reported it on the grounds of a false rumor.

entries.zh: 是時，法尚深刻，藩郡凡奏刑殺，不究其實，即順其請，故當時從事鮮賓客之禮，重足一跡而事之，猶不能免其禍焉。
entries.en: At this time the law still ran harsh; whenever a regional command requested an execution, the court did not investigate but simply complied. Staff therefore rarely treated their superiors with guest courtesy—they served them treading on eggshells—and still could not escape disaster.
entries.literal: At this time the law still tended toward severity; whenever a regional command submitted a request for execution, the court did not investigate the facts but simply granted the request. Therefore the staff at the time rarely observed the courtesy due to guests when serving their superiors—they walked treading in one another's footprints—and still could not escape calamity.

entries.zh: 壬子，以工部侍郎李穀充西南面行營都轉運使。
entries.en: On renzi Li Gu, Vice Minister of Works, was appointed chief transport commissioner of the southwestern campaign headquarters.
entries.literal: On renzi, Li Gu, Vice Minister of Works, was appointed to serve as chief transport commissioner of the southwestern campaign headquarters.

entries.zh: 乙卯，禮儀使張昭上高祖廟尊號，獻舞名並歌辭，舞曲請以「觀德」為名，歌辭不錄。
entries.en: On yimao Ritual Commissioner Zhang Zhao submitted the honorific for Gaozu's temple, along with the proposed dance name and lyrics; he asked that the dance be named "Observing Virtue," and the lyrics were not recorded.
entries.literal: On yimao, Ritual Commissioner Zhang Zhao submitted the honorific title for the temple of Emperor Gaozu, together with the name of the dance and its lyrics; he requested that the dance be named "Observing Virtue," and the lyrics were not recorded.

entries.zh: 丙辰，以久旱，幸道宮、佛寺禱雨，是日大澍。
entries.en: On bingchen, because of prolonged drought, the emperor visited Daoist temples and Buddhist monasteries to pray for rain; that day brought a great downpour.
entries.literal: On bingchen, because of prolonged drought, the Emperor visited Daoist temples and Buddhist monasteries to pray for rain; that day there was a great soaking rain.

entries.zh: 開封言，陽武、雍丘、襄邑三縣，蝗為鴝鵒聚食，詔禁捕鴝鵒。
entries.en: Kaifeng reported that in Yangwu, Yongqiu, and Xiangyi counties locusts were being gathered and eaten by crested mynas; an edict forbade capturing the birds.
entries.literal: Kaifeng reported that in the three counties of Yangwu, Yongqiu, and Xiangyi, locusts were being gathered and eaten by crested mynas; an edict forbade the capture of crested mynas.

entries.zh: 庚申，樞密使郭威加同平章事。
entries.en: On gengshen Military Affairs Commissioner Guo Wei was additionally made Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank.
entries.literal: On gengshen, Guo Wei, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was given the additional title of Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank.

entries.zh: 辛酉，滄州上言，自今年七月後，幽州界投來人口凡五千一百四十七，北土饑故也。
entries.en: On xinyou Cang Prefecture reported that since the seventh month of this year 5,147 people had fled across the border from You Prefecture, all because famine gripped the northern regions.
entries.literal: On xinyou, Cang Prefecture reported that since the seventh month of this year, people who had fled across the border from You Prefecture totaled 5,147—all because the northern regions were suffering famine.

entries.zh: 乙丑，以宣徽北院使王峻為宣徽南院使，以內客省使吳虔裕為宣徽北院使。
entries.en: On yichou Wang Jun, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made Commissioner of the Southern Bureau, and Wu Qianyu, Commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau, was made Commissioner of the Northern Bureau.
entries.literal: On yichou, Wang Jun, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was appointed Commissioner of the Southern Bureau; Wu Qianyu, Commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau, was appointed Commissioner of the Northern Bureau.

entries.zh: 戊辰，以遂州節度使兼侍衛親軍馬軍都指揮使李洪信為澶州節度使，以澶州節度使郭從義為永興軍節度使兼行營都部署。
entries.en: On wuchen Li Hongxin, military governor of Suizhou and commander-in-chief of the Imperial Guard Cavalry, was made military governor of Chan Prefecture, and Guo Congyi, military governor of Chan Prefecture, was made military governor of the Yongxing Army and field headquarters commissioner.
entries.literal: On wuchen, Li Hongxin, military governor of Suizhou and commander-in-chief of the Imperial Guard Cavalry, was appointed military governor of Chan Prefecture; Guo Congyi, military governor of Chan Prefecture, was appointed military governor of the Yongxing Army and field headquarters commissioner.

entries.zh: 庚午，故兵部尚書李懌贈尚書左僕射。
entries.en: On gengwu the late Minister of War Li Yi was posthumously made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
entries.literal: On gengwu, the late Minister of War Li Yi was posthumously conferred the title of Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

entries.zh: 鎮州奏，準詔處斬節度副使張鵬訖。
entries.en: Zhen Prefecture reported that pursuant to edict, Deputy Military Governor Zhang Peng had been executed.
entries.literal: Zhen Prefecture reported that in accordance with an edict, Deputy Military Governor Zhang Peng had been executed.

entries.zh: 鵬以一言之失，為鄴帥高行周所奏，故命誅之。
entries.en: Peng had misspoken and was denounced by Gao Xingzhou, Yedu garrison commander; he was therefore ordered executed.
entries.literal: Peng had committed a slip of the tongue and was denounced by Gao Xingzhou, Yedu garrison commander; therefore he was ordered to be put to death.

entries.zh: 乙亥，新授鳳翔節度使趙暉奏，與八作使王繼濤領部下兵同赴鳳翔。
entries.en: On yihai Zhao Hui, newly appointed military governor of Fengxiang, reported that he and Commissioner of the Eight Works Wang Jitao were leading their troops together to Fengxiang.
entries.literal: On yihai, the newly appointed military governor of Fengxiang, Zhao Hui, memorialized that he and Wang Jitao, Commissioner of the Eight Works, were leading their troops together to Fengxiang.

entries.zh: 時王景崇拒命故也。
entries.en: The move was made because Wang Jingchong was then defying court orders.
entries.literal: This was because Wang Jingchong was defying orders at the time.

entries.zh: 八月己卯，以華州節度使侯章為邠州節度使，以左金吾上將軍扈彥珂為華州節度使。
entries.en: In the eighth month, on jimao, Hou Zhang, military governor of Hua Prefecture, was transferred to military governor of Bin Prefecture, and Hu Yanke, Left Golden Crow Senior General, was made military governor of Hua Prefecture.
entries.literal: In the eighth month, on jimao, Hou Zhang, military governor of Hua Prefecture, was appointed military governor of Bin Prefecture; Hu Yanke, Left Golden Crow Senior General, was appointed military governor of Hua Prefecture.

entries.zh: 壬午，命樞密使郭威赴河中府軍前，詔河府、永興、鳳翔行營諸軍，一稟威節制。
entries.en: On renwu Military Affairs Commissioner Guo Wei was ordered to the front at Hezhong, and all field armies of Hezhong, Yongxing, and Fengxiang were commanded to obey him exclusively.
entries.literal: On renwu, Military Affairs Commissioner Guo Wei was ordered to proceed to the army before Hezhong Prefecture; an edict commanded all field-army forces of Hezhong Prefecture, Yongxing, and Fengxiang to obey Wei's unified command.

entries.zh: 時李守貞、王景崇、趙思綰連衡作叛，朝廷雖命白文珂、常思攻討河中，物議以二帥非守貞之敵，中外憂之，及是命之降，人情大愜。
entries.en: At this time Li Shouzhen, Wang Jingchong, and Zhao Sixuan had allied in rebellion. Although the court had ordered Bai Wenke and Chang Si to campaign against Hezhong, opinion held that neither commander was Shouzhen's equal, and alarm spread throughout the realm; when this order came down, people were greatly relieved.
entries.literal: At this time Li Shouzhen, Wang Jingchong, and Zhao Sixuan had allied in rebellion; although the court had ordered Bai Wenke and Chang Si to attack and suppress Hezhong, popular opinion held that the two commanders were no match for Shouzhen, and alarm spread within and outside the court; when this appointment was issued, public sentiment was greatly satisfied.

entries.zh: 癸巳，以奉國左廂都指揮使、閬州防禦使劉詞為夔州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使兼河中行營都虞候；
entries.en: On guisi Liu Ci, commander of the Left Wing of the Fengguo Army and defense commissioner of Lang Prefecture, was made military governor of Kui Prefecture and appointed commander of the palace guard infantry and chief adjutant of the Hezhong field headquarters;
entries.literal: On guisi, Liu Ci, overall commander of the Left Wing of the Fengguo Army and defense commissioner of Lang Prefecture, was appointed military governor of Kui Prefecture and appointed commander-in-chief of the palace guard infantry and chief adjutant of the Hezhong field headquarters;

entries.zh: 以護聖左廂都指揮使、岳州防禦使李洪義為遂州節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使。
entries.en: Li Hongyi, commander of the Left Wing of the Husheng Army and defense commissioner of Yue Prefecture, was made military governor of Suizhou and appointed commander of the palace guard cavalry.
entries.literal: Li Hongyi, overall commander of the Left Wing of the Husheng Army and defense commissioner of Yue Prefecture, was appointed military governor of Suizhou and appointed commander-in-chief of the palace guard cavalry.

entries.zh: 乙未，兩浙節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中、吳越國王錢宏俶加檢校太師、兼中書令、東南面兵馬都元帥。
entries.en: On yiwei Qian Hongchu, military governor of the Two Zhes, Acting Grand Commandant, Concurrent Palace Attendant, and King of Wuyue, was promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Chief Councilor, and Grand Marshal of the southeast.
entries.literal: On yiwei, Qian Hongchu, military governor of the Two Zhes, Acting Grand Commandant, Concurrent Palace Attendant, and King of Wuyue, was additionally made Acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Chief Councilor, and Grand Marshal of the southeastern forces.

entries.zh: 宏俶，故吳越王元瓘之子也。
entries.en: Hongchu was a son of the former King of Wuyue, Qian Yuanguan.
entries.literal: Hongchu was the son of the former King of Wuyue, Qian Yuanguan.

entries.zh: 先是，其兄宏倧襲父位，尋為部下所廢，以宏俶代之，故特加是命焉。
entries.en: Earlier his elder brother Hongzong had succeeded their father, but was soon deposed by his own men and replaced by Hongchu; he therefore received this special promotion.
entries.literal: Earlier, his elder brother Hongzong had succeeded to their father's position, but soon was deposed by his subordinates and replaced by Hongchu; therefore this special appointment was made.

entries.zh: 新授鳳翔節度使趙暉奏，部署兵士赴鳳翔城下。
entries.en: Zhao Hui, newly appointed military governor of Fengxiang, reported that he had deployed his troops beneath the walls of Fengxiang.
entries.literal: Zhao Hui, the newly appointed military governor of Fengxiang, memorialized that he had deployed his troops to the foot of the walls of Fengxiang.

entries.zh: 癸卯，郭威奏，今月二十三日，大軍已抵河府賊城；
entries.en: On guimao Guo Wei reported that on the twenty-third day of this month the main army had reached the rebel walls at Hezhong;
entries.literal: On guimao, Guo Wei memorialized that on the twenty-third day of this month the main army had already reached the rebel city of Hezhong Prefecture;

entries.zh: 至二十六日，開長連塹畢，築長連城次。
entries.en: By the twenty-sixth the long linked trenches were finished, and work on the long linked wall began next.
entries.literal: By the twenty-sixth day, the digging of the long linked trenches was completed, and construction of the long linked wall followed.

entries.zh: 九月戊申，侯益部曲王守筠自鳳翔來奔，言益家屬盡為王景崇所害。
entries.en: In the ninth month, on wushen, Wang Shouyun, a retainer in Hou Yi's command, fled from Fengxiang and reported that Wang Jingchong had killed all of Yi's family.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on wushen, Wang Shouyun, a retainer in Hou Yi's command, fled from Fengxiang and reported that all of Yi's family had been killed by Wang Jingchong.

entries.zh: 壬子，郭威奏，破河府賊軍於城下。
entries.en: On renzi Guo Wei reported a victory over the Hezhong rebel army beneath the city walls.
entries.literal: On renzi, Guo Wei memorialized that he had defeated the rebel army of Hezhong Prefecture beneath the walls.

entries.zh: 甲寅，故夔州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使尚洪遷贈太尉。
entries.en: On jiayin Shang Hongqian, late military governor of Kui Prefecture and commander of the palace guard infantry, was posthumously made Grand Commandant.
entries.literal: On jiayin, the late Shang Hongqian, military governor of Kui Prefecture and commander-in-chief of the palace guard infantry, was posthumously conferred the title of Grand Commandant.

entries.zh: 乙丑，雪，書不時也。
entries.en: On yichou it snowed—recorded as an untimely occurrence.
entries.literal: On yichou, snow; the annals record it as out of season.

entries.zh: 戊辰，鳳翔都部署趙暉奏，大破川軍於大散關，殺三千餘人，其餘棄甲而遁。
entries.en: On wuchen Zhao Hui, overall commander at Fengxiang, reported a major victory over Shu forces at Dasanguan, with more than three thousand killed; the rest threw off their armor and fled.
entries.literal: On wuchen, Zhao Hui, overall deployment commissioner of Fengxiang, memorialized that he had inflicted a great defeat on the Shu army at Dasanguan, killing more than three thousand men; the rest cast off their armor and fled.

entries.zh: 〈（《隆平集》：藥元福從趙暉進討，兵眾寡數倍，他將皆為卻，元福擁數百騎獨出，令曰：「敢回頭者斬。」
entries.en: (From the Longping Collection: Yao Yuanfu followed Zhao Hui in the advance; the enemy outnumbered them several times over and other generals were all forced back; Yuanfu alone rode out at the head of several hundred horsemen and commanded: "Whoever turns back shall be beheaded."
entries.literal: (From the Longping Collection: Yao Yuanfu followed Zhao Hui in the advance to attack; the enemy forces were several times more numerous, and the other generals were all driven back; Yuanfu alone led several hundred horsemen forward and ordered: "Whoever turns back shall be beheaded."

entries.zh: 眾效死以戰，遂有成功。）〉
entries.en: His men fought to the death and won the victory.)〉
entries.literal: The men fought to the death, and thereby achieved success.)〉

entries.zh: 壬申，郭威奏，得郭從義報，今月十四日，鳳翔王景崇兵士離本城，尋遣監軍李彥從率兵襲至法門寺西，殺戮二千餘人。
entries.en: On renshen Guo Wei reported that he had received word from Guo Congyi: on the fourteenth day of this month Fengxiang's Wang Jingchong had withdrawn his troops from the city; he then sent army supervisor Li Yanchong to strike west of Famen Temple and kill more than two thousand men.
entries.literal: On renshen, Guo Wei memorialized that he had received a report from Guo Congyi: on the fourteenth day of this month, the soldiers of Wang Jingchong of Fengxiang had left their city; he then sent the army supervisor Li Yanchong to lead troops in an attack west of Famen Temple, killing more than two thousand men.

entries.zh: 詔升河中府解縣為解州。
entries.en: An edict elevated Jie County of Hezhong Prefecture to Jie Prefecture.
entries.literal: An edict elevated Jie County of Hezhong Prefecture to Jie Prefecture.

entries.zh: 冬十月丙子朔，山陵使竇貞固上大行皇帝陵名曰睿陵，從之。
entries.en: On the first day of the tenth month in winter, bingzi, tomb commissioner Dou Zhengu submitted the late emperor's tomb name as Ruiling, and the court approved it.
entries.literal: On the first day of the tenth month in winter, bingzi, Dou Zhengu, commissioner for the imperial tomb, submitted the name of the late emperor's tomb as Ruiling; the request was granted.

entries.zh: 丁丑夕，歲星入太微。
entries.en: On the evening of dingchou the Year Star entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
entries.literal: On the evening of dingchou, the Year Star entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

entries.zh: 戊寅，趙暉奏，破王景崇賊軍於鳳翔城下。
entries.en: On wuyin Zhao Hui reported a victory over Wang Jingchong's rebel army beneath the walls of Fengxiang.
entries.literal: On wuyin, Zhao Hui memorialized that he had defeated the rebel army of Wang Jingchong beneath the walls of Fengxiang.

entries.zh: 甲申，吐番遣使獻方物。
entries.en: On jiashen Tibetan envoys presented local products at court.
entries.literal: On jiashen, the Tibetans sent envoys presenting local products.

entries.zh: 丙戌，右羽林將軍張播停任，坐檢田受請托也。
entries.en: On bingxu Zhang Bo, General of the Right Feathered Forest, was suspended for accepting bribes during field inspection.
entries.literal: On bingxu, Zhang Bo, General of the Right Feathered Forest, was suspended from office for having accepted bribes while inspecting fields.

entries.zh: 丁亥，中書舍人張誼責授房州司戶，兵部郎中馬承翰責授慶州司戶，並員外置，所在馳驛發遣。
entries.en: On dinghai Zhang Yi, Secretariat Drafter, was demoted to Registrar of Fang Prefecture, and Ma Chenghan, Director of the War Bureau, to Registrar of Qing Prefecture; both were appointed as supernumeraries and sent post-haste to their posts.
entries.literal: On dinghai, Zhang Yi, Secretariat Drafter, was demoted and appointed Registrar of Fang Prefecture; Ma Chenghan, Director of the War Bureau, was demoted and appointed Registrar of Qing Prefecture; both were appointed as supernumeraries and dispatched post-haste to their posts.

entries.zh: 先是，誼與承翰俱銜命於兩浙，睹其驕僭之失，形於譏誚，兼乘醉有輕肆之言，錢宏俶恥之，摭其過以奏之，朝廷以方務懷柔，故有是命。
entries.en: Earlier Yi and Chenghan had both been sent on missions to the Two Zhes. Seeing their arrogance, they mocked them openly and, while drunk, spoke recklessly. Qian Hongchu, humiliated, reported their offenses to court; because the court was then pursuing conciliation, these demotions followed.
entries.literal: Earlier, Yi and Chenghan had both been entrusted with missions to the Two Zhes; witnessing their arrogant transgressions, they expressed mockery, and while drunk made reckless remarks. Qian Hongchu was shamed by this and gathered their faults to memorialize the court; because the court was then pursuing a policy of conciliation, this order was issued.

entries.zh: 甲辰，延州奏，夏州李彜殷先出兵臨州境，欲應接李守貞，今卻抽退。
entries.en: On jiachen Yan Prefecture reported that Li Yiyin of Xia Prefecture had first sent troops to Lin Prefecture's border to support Li Shouzhen, but had now withdrawn.
entries.literal: On jiachen, Yan Prefecture memorialized that Li Yiyin of Xia Prefecture had first sent troops to the border of Lin Prefecture intending to support Li Shouzhen, but had now withdrawn.

entries.zh: 隱皇帝，諱承祐，高祖第二子也。
entries.en: Emperor Yin, whose personal name was Chengyou, was Gaozu's second son.
entries.literal: Emperor Yin, taboo name Chengyou, was the second son of Gaozu.

entries.zh: 母曰李太后，以唐長興二年，歲在辛卯，三月七日，生帝於鄴都之舊第。
entries.en: His mother was Empress Dowager Li. In the second year of the Tang era Changxing (xinmao), on the seventh day of the third month, the emperor was born at the family's former residence in Yedu.
entries.literal: His mother was called Empress Dowager Li. In the second year of Changxing of Tang, the year being xinmao, on the seventh day of the third month, the Emperor was born at the old residence in Yedu.

entries.zh: 高祖鎮太原，署節院使，累官至檢校尚書右僕射。
entries.en: While Gaozu was stationed at Taiyuan, he was appointed military commissioner of the headquarters staff and rose through the ranks to Acting Minister of the Right in the Department of State Affairs.
entries.literal: When Gaozu held Taiyuan, he was appointed commissioner of the military commissioner's office, and through successive promotions reached Acting Minister of the Right in the Department of State Affairs.

entries.zh: 國初，授左衛大將軍、檢校司空，遷大內都點檢、檢校太保。
entries.en: At the founding of the dynasty he was made General of the Left Guard and Acting Minister of Works, then promoted to Grand Inspector of the Inner Palace and Acting Grand Guardian.
entries.literal: At the founding of the state, he was appointed General of the Left Guard and Acting Minister of Works, then transferred to Grand Inspector of the Inner Palace and Acting Grand Guardian.

entries.zh: 壬子，賜前昭義軍節度使張從恩衣一襲，金帶、鞍馬、彩帛等。
entries.en: On renzi, the former military governor of Zhaoyi, Zhang Cong'en, was granted one suit of clothing, a gold belt, a saddle horse, colored silks, and the like.
entries.literal: On renzi, bestowed on the former military governor of Zhaoyi, Zhang Cong'en, one suit of clothing, a gold belt, saddle horse, colored silks, and the like.

entries.zh: 時有投無名文字誣告從恩者，故特有是賜，以安其心。
entries.en: At the time anonymous writings were submitted to slander and accuse Cong'en; therefore this special grant was made to reassure him.
entries.literal: At the time there were anonymous writings submitted to slander and accuse Cong'en; therefore there was this special bestowal to settle his mind.

entries.zh: 乙卯，河府軍前奏，今月四日夜，賊軍偷斫河西寨，捕斬七百餘級。
entries.en: On yimao, the Hezhong army front reported that on the night of the fourth of this month rebel troops had secretly attacked the Hexi camp; over seven hundred were captured and beheaded.
entries.literal: On yimao, the Hezhong army front reported: on the night of the fourth of this month, rebel troops secretly cut at the Hexi camp; over seven hundred were captured and beheaded.

entries.zh: 時蜀軍自大散關來援王景崇，郭威自將兵赴岐下，將行，戒白文珂、劉詞等曰：「賊之驍勇，並在城西，慎為儆備。」
entries.en: At the time Shu troops came from Dasan Pass to aid Wang Jingchong. Guo Wei personally led troops toward Qizhou. Before departing he admonished Bai Wenke, Liu Ci, and the others: "The rebels' fierce warriors are all west of the city—take strict precautions."
entries.literal: At the time Shu troops came from Dasan Pass to aid Wang Jingchong; Guo Wei personally led troops to Qixia. About to depart, he admonished Bai Wenke, Liu Ci, and others, saying: "The rebels' fierce warriors are all west of the city—be careful in keeping strict guard."

entries.zh: 既行，至華州，聞川軍退敗，且憂文珂等為賊奔突，遂兼程而回。
entries.en: After setting out he reached Hua Prefecture, heard that the Shu army had retreated in defeat, and also feared that Wenke and the others might be overrun in a sudden rebel rush, so he returned by forced marches.
entries.literal: Having set out, he reached Hua Prefecture, heard that the Shu army had retreated in defeat, and also feared that Wenke and the others might be overrun by rebels in a sudden rush, so he returned by forced marches.

entries.zh: 賊城內偵知郭威西行，於正月四日夜，遣賊將王三鐵等，
entries.en: Spies within the rebel city learned that Guo Wei had gone west. On the night of the fourth day of the first month they sent the rebel generals Wang Santie and others,
entries.literal: Spies within the rebel city learned that Guo Wei had gone west; on the night of the fourth day of the first month they sent the rebel generals Wang Santie and others,

entries.zh: 〈（《宋史·王繼勛傳》：繼勛有武勇，在軍陣常用鐵鞭、鐵槊、鐵楇，軍中目為「王三鐵」。）〉
entries.en: (《Song History·Biography of Wang Jixun》: Jixun had martial valor; in battle he commonly used an iron whip, iron spear, and iron mace, and the army called him "Wang Santie.")〉
entries.literal: (《Song History·Biography of Wang Jixun》: Jixun had martial valor; in battle arrays he commonly used an iron whip, iron spear, and iron mace, and in the army he was called "Wang Santie.")〉

entries.zh: 率驍勇千餘人，沿流南行，坎岸而登，為三道來攻。
entries.en: leading over a thousand fierce warriors south along the stream, climbing the bank by steps, and attacking in three columns.
entries.literal: leading over a thousand fierce warriors south along the stream, climbing the bank by steps, and attacking in three columns.

entries.zh: 賊軍已入王師寨中，劉詞極力拒之，短兵既接，遂敗之。
entries.en: The rebel army had already entered the imperial army's camp. Liu Ci resisted with all his strength, and once close combat was joined he defeated them.
entries.literal: The rebel army had already entered the imperial army's camp; Liu Ci resisted with all his strength; once close combat was joined, he defeated them.

entries.zh: 秋七月辛亥，湖南奏，析長沙縣東界為龍喜縣。
entries.en: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinhai, Hunan memorialized that the eastern border of Changsha County was divided off to form Longxi County.
entries.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinhai, Hunan memorialized: the eastern border of Changsha County was divided off to form Longxi County.

entries.zh: 從之。
entries.en: The request was approved.
entries.literal: The request was followed.

entries.zh: 丙辰，樞密使郭威奏，收復河府羅城，李守貞退保子城。
entries.en: On bingchen, the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei memorialized that the outer wall of Hezhong had been recovered and Li Shouzhen had withdrawn to hold the inner city.
entries.literal: On bingchen, the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei memorialized: the outer wall of Hezhong was recovered; Li Shouzhen withdrew to hold the inner city.

entries.zh: 丁巳，永興都部署郭從義奏：「新除華州留後趙思綰，自今月三日授華州留後，準詔赴任，三移行期，仍要鎧甲以給牙兵，及與之，竟不遵路。
entries.en: On dingsi, the Yongxing commander-in-chief Guo Congyi memorialized: "The newly appointed acting military governor of Hua, Zhao Sizhan, was appointed on the third of this month and should by edict proceed to his post. Three times the departure date was moved, yet he still demanded armor to supply his personal guard. When it was given him, in the end he did not take the road.
entries.literal: On dingsi, the Yongxing commander-in-chief Guo Congyi memorialized: "The newly appointed acting military governor of Hua, Zhao Sizhan, from the third of this month when he was appointed acting governor of Hua, should by edict proceed to his post; three times the departure date was moved, yet he still demanded armor to supply his personal guard; when it was given him, in the end he did not take the road.

entries.zh: 至九日夕，有部曲曹彥進告，思綰欲於十一日夜與同惡五百人奔南山入蜀。
entries.en: By the evening of the ninth a subordinate, Cao Yanjin, reported that Sizhan intended on the night of the eleventh, with five hundred fellow villains, to flee south into the mountains and enter Shu.
entries.literal: By the evening of the ninth, a subordinate, Cao Yanjin, reported that Sizhan intended on the night of the eleventh, with five hundred fellow villains, to flee south into the mountains and enter Shu.

entries.zh: 是日詰旦，再促上路，雲俟夜進途。
entries.en: At dawn that day he was again urged to take the road; he said he would wait for night to set out.
entries.literal: At dawn that day he was again urged to take the road; he said he would wait for night to advance on the journey.

entries.zh: 臣尋與王峻入城，分兵守四門，其趙思綰部下軍，各已執帶，遂至牙署，令趙思綰至則執之，與一行徒黨，並處置訖。」
entries.en: Your servant then entered the city with Wang Jun and divided troops to guard the four gates. Sizhan's subordinate troops had all already belted on their arms. We then reached the headquarters office, seized Zhao Sizhan when he arrived, and dealt with him and his whole party of followers."
entries.literal: Your servant then entered the city with Wang Jun, divided troops to guard the four gates; Sizhan's subordinate troops had all already belted on arms; we then reached the headquarters office, ordered that when Zhao Sizhan arrived he should be seized, and together with his whole party of followers all were dealt with."

entries.zh: 甲子，樞密使郭威奏，收復河中府，逆賊李守貞自燔而死。
entries.en: On jiazi, the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei memorialized that Hezhong Prefecture had been recovered and the rebel Li Shouzhen had burned himself to death.
entries.literal: On jiazi, the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei memorialized: Hezhong Prefecture was recovered; the rebel Li Shouzhen burned himself to death.

entries.zh: 丙寅，以權涼州留後折逋嘉施為河西軍節度留後。
entries.en: On bingyin, the acting Liang Prefecture military governor Zhebo Jiashi was appointed acting military governor of the Hexi Army.
entries.literal: On bingyin, the acting Liang Prefecture military governor Zhebo Jiashi was made acting military governor of the Hexi Army.

entries.zh: 兗州奏，捕蝗二萬斛。
entries.en: Yan Prefecture reported capturing twenty thousand hu of locusts.
entries.literal: Yan Prefecture reported capturing twenty thousand hu of locusts.

entries.zh: 丁卯，前洺州團練使武漢球卒。
entries.en: On dingmao, the former Ming Prefecture regiment-training commissioner Wu Hanqiu died.
entries.literal: On dingmao, the former Ming Prefecture regiment-training commissioner Wu Hanqiu died.

entries.zh: 戊辰，永興軍節度使兼兵馬都部署郭從義加同平章事，徙華州節度使。
entries.en: On wuchen, the Yongxing military governor and concurrent commander of army and horse Guo Congyi was given the additional title of Grand Councilor and transferred to military governor of Hua.
entries.literal: On wuchen, the Yongxing military governor and concurrent commander of army and horse Guo Congyi was given the additional title of Grand Councilor and transferred to military governor of Hua.

entries.zh: 郭從義奏，處斬前巡檢使喬守溫，供奉官王益、時知化、任繼勛等。
entries.en: Guo Congyi memorialized that the former inspection commissioner Qiao Shouwen and the palace service officials Wang Yi, Shi Zhihua, Ren Jixun, and others had been executed.
entries.literal: Guo Congyi memorialized that the former inspection commissioner Qiao Shouwen, the palace service officials Wang Yi, Shi Zhihua, Ren Jixun, and others were executed.

entries.zh: 守溫受高祖命巡檢京兆，會王益自鳳翔押送趙思綰等赴闕，行至京兆，守溫迎益於郊外，思綰等突然作亂，遂據其城。
entries.en: Shouwen had received Gaozu's order to inspect Jingzhao. Wang Yi was escorting Zhao Sizhan and others from Fengxiang to the capital. When they reached Jingzhao, Shouwen welcomed Yi in the suburbs, but Sizhan and the others suddenly rose in revolt and seized the city.
entries.literal: Shouwen had received Gaozu's order to inspect Jingzhao; it happened that Wang Yi was escorting Zhao Sizhan and others from Fengxiang to the capital; when they reached Jingzhao, Shouwen welcomed Yi in the suburbs; Sizhan and the others suddenly rose in revolt and thus seized the city.

entries.zh: 及郭從義率兵攻討，令守溫部署役夫。
entries.en: When Guo Congyi led troops to attack and suppress them, he ordered Shouwen to deploy corvée laborers.
entries.literal: When Guo Congyi led troops to attack and suppress them, he ordered Shouwen to deploy corvée laborers.

entries.zh: 守溫有愛姬陷在賊城，為思綰所錄，及收城，從義盡得思綰之婢仆，守溫求其愛姬，從義雖與之，意有所慊，遂發前罪，密啟於郭威，請除之，與王益等並誅焉。
entries.en: Shouwen had a beloved concubine trapped in the rebel city who had been taken by Sizhan. When the city was recovered, Congyi obtained all of Sizhan's maids and servants. Shouwen asked for his beloved concubine. Though Congyi gave her to him, he was not satisfied and exposed Shouwen's former crime, secretly reporting to Guo Wei and requesting his removal. Shouwen and Wang Yi and the others were all put to death.
entries.literal: Shouwen had a beloved concubine trapped in the rebel city who was taken by Sizhan; when the city was recovered, Congyi obtained all of Sizhan's maids and servants; Shouwen asked for his beloved concubine; though Congyi gave her to him, in his mind he was not satisfied, so he exposed the former crime, secretly reported to Guo Wei, and requested that Shouwen be removed—he and Wang Yi and the others were all put to death.

entries.zh: 兗州奏，捕蝗四萬斛。
entries.en: Yan Prefecture reported capturing forty thousand hu of locusts.
entries.literal: Yan Prefecture reported capturing forty thousand hu of locusts.

entries.zh: 壬午，西京留臺侍御史趙礪彈奏，太子太保王延、太子洗馬張季凝等，自去年五月後來，每稱請假，俱是不任拜起。
entries.en: On renwu, the Western Capital deputy censor Zhao Li impeached the Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent Wang Yan, the Heir Apparent's Stud Zhang Jining, and others: since the fifth month of last year, whenever they claimed leave they were all unable to perform bowing and rising.
entries.literal: On renwu, the Western Capital deputy censor Zhao Li impeached: the Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent Wang Yan, the Heir Apparent's Stud Zhang Jining, and others, since the fifth month of last year, whenever they claimed leave were all unable to perform bowing and rising.

entries.zh: 詔延等宜以本官致仕。
entries.en: An edict ordered Yan and the others to retire with their present offices.
entries.literal: An edict ordered Yan and the others to retire with their present offices.

entries.zh: 甲申，以陜州節度使、充河中一行兵馬都部署白文珂為西京留守，加兼侍中；
entries.en: On jiashen, the Shan Prefecture military governor and concurrent commander of the Hezhong campaign army and horse Bai Wenke was appointed Western Capital military commissioner with the additional title of Palace Attendant;
entries.literal: On jiashen, the Shan Prefecture military governor and concurrent commander of the Hezhong campaign army and horse Bai Wenke was made Western Capital military commissioner, with the additional title of Palace Attendant;

entries.zh: 潞州節度使、充河中一行副都署常思加檢校太師；
entries.en: the Lu Prefecture military governor and concurrent deputy commander of the Hezhong campaign Chang Si was given the additional title of Acting Grand Preceptor;
entries.literal: the Lu Prefecture military governor and concurrent deputy commander of the Hezhong campaign Chang Si was given the additional title of Acting Grand Preceptor;

entries.zh: 以右散騎常侍盧撰為戶部侍郎致仕。
entries.en: and the Right Regular Attendant Lu Zhuan was made Vice Minister of Revenue and retired.
entries.literal: the Right Regular Attendant Lu Zhuan was made Vice Minister of Revenue and retired.

entries.zh: 辛卯，右拾遺高守瓊上言：「仕官年未三十，請不除授縣令。」
entries.en: On xinmao, the Right Reminder Gao Shouqiong submitted: "Officials not yet thirty years of age should not be appointed county magistrates."
entries.literal: On xinmao, the Right Reminder Gao Shouqiong submitted: "Officials not yet thirty years of age should not be appointed county magistrates."

entries.zh: 詔：「起今後諸色選人，年及七十者，宜註優散官；
entries.en: An edict proclaimed: "From now on, for candidates of all categories, those reaching seventy years should be registered for honorary scattered offices;
entries.literal: An edict proclaimed: "From now on, for candidates of all categories, those reaching seventy years should be registered for honorary scattered offices;

entries.zh: 年少未歷資考者，不得註擬縣令。」
entries.en: those young and not yet having passed seniority examinations may not be registered for appointment as county magistrates."
entries.literal: those young and not yet having passed seniority examinations may not be registered for appointment as county magistrates."

entries.zh: 癸巳，以翰林學士、工部尚書張沆為禮部尚書。
entries.en: On guisi, the Hanlin academician and Minister of Works Zhang Hong was appointed Minister of Rites.
entries.literal: On guisi, the Hanlin academician and Minister of Works Zhang Hong was made Minister of Rites.

entries.zh: 沆卜葬先人，以內署無例乞假，乃上章請解職，以赴葬事，遂落職以遣之。
entries.en: Hong was arranging burial for his forebears. Because the inner secretariat had no precedent for requesting leave, he submitted a memorial asking to resign his post to attend to the burial, and was removed from office and sent off.
entries.literal: Hong was divining burial for his forebears; because the inner secretariat had no precedent for requesting leave, he submitted a memorial asking to resign his post to attend to the burial affairs, and so was removed from office and sent off.

entries.zh: 乙未，宣徽南院使、永興行營兵馬都監王峻，宣徽北院使、河府行營兵馬都監吳虔裕，並加檢校太傅。
entries.en: On yiwei, the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat commissioner and Yongxing campaign army and horse inspector Wang Jun, and the Northern Bureau commissioner and Hezhong campaign army and horse inspector Wu Qianyu, were both given the additional title of Acting Grand Tutor.
entries.literal: On yiwei, the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat commissioner and Yongxing campaign army and horse inspector Wang Jun, and the Northern Bureau commissioner and Hezhong campaign army and horse inspector Wu Qianyu, were both given the additional title of Acting Grand Tutor.

entries.zh: 九月乙己，樞密使郭威檢校太師、兼侍中，宋州節度使兼侍衛親軍都指揮使史宏肇加兼中書令。
entries.en: In the ninth month, on the yisi day, the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei was made Acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Palace Attendant, and the Song Prefecture military governor and concurrent commander of the Imperial Guards Shi Hongzhao was given the additional title of Grand Councilor.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on the yisi day, the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei was made Acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Palace Attendant; the Song Prefecture military governor and concurrent commander of the Imperial Guards Shi Hongzhao was given the additional title of Grand Councilor.

entries.zh: 初，郭威平河中回，朝廷議加恩，威奏曰：「臣出兵已來，輦轂之下，無犬吠之憂，俾臣得專一其事，軍旅所聚，資糧不乏，此皆居中大臣鎮撫謀畫之功也，臣安敢獨擅其美乎！」
entries.en: When Guo Wei returned from pacifying Hezhong, the court discussed extending favors. Wei memorialized: "Since I led troops forth, the capital has had no worry of disturbance, enabling me to devote myself to this campaign alone. Where armies gathered, supplies were not lacking—all this is the achievement of the great ministers at court in calming affairs and planning strategy. How dare I monopolize the credit!"
entries.literal: Initially, when Guo Wei returned from pacifying Hezhong, the court discussed extending favors. Wei memorialized: "Since your servant led troops forth, beneath the imperial chariot there has been no worry of dogs barking, enabling your servant to devote himself to this affair alone. Where armies gathered, supplies were not lacking—all this is the achievement of the great ministers at court in calming and planning. How dare your servant monopolize the credit!"

entries.zh: 帝然之，於是宏肇與宰相、樞密使、三司使，次第加恩。
entries.en: The emperor approved, and then Hongzhao, the chief ministers, the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, and the Commissioner of the Three Departments received favors in sequence.
entries.literal: The Emperor approved, and then Hongzhao, the chief ministers, the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, and the Commissioner of the Three Departments received favors in sequence.

entries.zh: 既而諸大臣以恩之所被，皆朝廷親近之臣，而宗室劉信及青州劉銖等皆國家元勛，必有不平之意，且外慮諸侯以朝廷有私於親近也，於是議及四方侯伯，普加恩焉。
entries.en: Then the great ministers reflected that those favored were all the court's intimate ministers, while the imperial clansman Liu Xin, Qing Prefecture's Liu Zhu, and others were all founding merit of the state and would surely feel discontent. They also feared that feudal lords would think the court showed partiality to intimates. Therefore they discussed extending favor to the lords and princes throughout the realm.
entries.literal: Then the great ministers reflected that those on whom favor had fallen were all the court's intimate ministers, while the imperial clansman Liu Xin and Qing Prefecture's Liu Zhu and others were all founding merit of the state and would surely feel discontent—and moreover they feared externally that feudal lords would think the court showed partiality to intimates—so they discussed extending favor to the lords and princes of the four directions universally.

entries.zh: 丙午，西京留守判官時彥澄、推官姜蟾、少尹崔淑並免居官，坐不隨府罷職，為留臺侍御史趙礪所彈也。
entries.en: On bingwu, the Western Capital military commissioner's adjutant Shi Yancheng, investigating officer Jiang Chan, and junior aide Cui Shu were all dismissed from office for failing to follow when the commissioner left his post, having been impeached by the deputy censor Zhao Li.
entries.literal: On bingwu, the Western Capital military commissioner's adjutant Shi Yancheng, investigating officer Jiang Chan, and junior aide Cui Shu were all dismissed from office, punished for not following when the commissioner left his post, impeached by the deputy censor Zhao Li.

entries.zh: 己酉，以右千牛上將軍孫漢赟為絳州刺史。
entries.en: On jiyou, the Right Thousand-Bull Upper General Sun Hanyun was appointed prefect of Jiang Prefecture.
entries.literal: On jiyou, the Right Thousand-Bull Upper General Sun Hanyun was made prefect of Jiang Prefecture.

entries.zh: 禮部尚書、判吏部尚書銓事王松停見任，坐子仁寶為李守貞從事也，尋卒於其第。
entries.en: The Minister of Rites and acting chief of Ministry of Personnel selection Wang Song was suspended from office because his son Renbao had served Li Shouzhen. Soon afterward he died at his residence.
entries.literal: The Minister of Rites and acting chief of Ministry of Personnel selection Wang Song was suspended from his present office, punished because his son Renbao had served Li Shouzhen; soon afterward he died at his residence.

entries.zh: 辛亥，宰臣竇貞固加守司徒，蘇逢吉加守司空，蘇禹珪加左僕射，楊邠加右僕射，依前兼樞密使。
entries.en: On xinhai, chief minister Dou Zhengu was given Acting Minister of Education, Su Fengji Acting Minister of Works, Su Yugui Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Yang Bin Right Vice Director, all continuing as before with concurrent Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner.
entries.literal: On xinhai, chief minister Dou Zhengu was given Acting Minister of Education; Su Fengji Acting Minister of Works; Su Yugui Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Yang Bin Right Vice Director, all continuing as before with concurrent Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner.

entries.zh: 太子太師致仕皇甫立卒。
entries.en: The retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Huangfu Li died.
entries.literal: The retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Huangfu Li died.

entries.zh: 癸丑，三司使王章加邑封。
entries.en: On guichou, the Commissioner of the Three Departments Wang Zhang received enlarged fief enfeoffment.
entries.literal: On guichou, the Commissioner of the Three Departments Wang Zhang received enlarged fief enfeoffment.

entries.zh: 乙卯，鄴都高行周加守太師，襄州安審琦加守太傅，兗州府符彥卿加守太保，北京劉崇加兼中書令。
entries.en: On yimao, Gao Xingzhou of Yedu was given Acting Grand Tutor, An Shenqi of Xiang Prefecture Acting Grand Mentor, Fu Yanqing of Yan Prefecture Acting Grand Guardian, and Liu Chong of Beijing the additional title of Grand Councilor.
entries.literal: On yimao, Yedu Gao Xingzhou was given Acting Grand Tutor; Xiang Prefecture An Shenqi Acting Grand Mentor; Yan Prefecture Fu Yanqing Acting Grand Guardian; Beijing Liu Chong the additional title of Grand Councilor.

entries.zh: 丁巳，澶州李洪信移鎮陜州，以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、遂州節度使李洪義為澶州節度使。
entries.en: On dingsi, Li Hongxin of Chan Prefecture was transferred to Shan Prefecture, and the Imperial Guard cavalry commander and Suizhou military governor Li Hongyi was appointed military governor of Chan Prefecture.
entries.literal: On dingsi, Chan Prefecture Li Hongxin was transferred to Shan Prefecture; the Imperial Guard cavalry commander and Suizhou military governor Li Hongyi was made military governor of Chan Prefecture.

entries.zh: 己未，許州劉信加兼侍中，開封尹侯益進封魯國公，鄆州慕容彥超、青州劉銖並加兼侍中。
entries.en: On jiwei, Liu Xin of Xu Prefecture was given the additional title of Palace Attendant, Kaifeng intendant Hou Yi was advanced to Duke of Lu, and Murong Yanchao of Yunzhou and Liu Zhu of Qing Prefecture were both given the additional title of Palace Attendant.
entries.literal: On jiwei, Xu Prefecture Liu Xin was given the additional title of Palace Attendant; Kaifeng intendant Hou Yi was advanced to Duke of Lu; Yunzhou Murong Yanchao and Qing Prefecture Liu Zhu were both given the additional title of Palace Attendant.

entries.zh: 湖南馬希廣奏，於八月十八日大破朗州馬希萼之眾。
entries.en: Ma Xiguang of Hunan memorialized that on the eighteenth of the eighth month he had greatly defeated the forces of Langzhou's Ma Xie.
entries.literal: Hunan Ma Xiguang memorialized: on the eighteenth of the eighth month he greatly defeated the forces of Langzhou's Ma Xie.

entries.zh: 辛酉，靈州馮暉、夏州李彜殷並加兼中書令。
entries.en: On xinyou, Feng Hui of Ling Prefecture and Li Yiyin of Xia Prefecture were both given the additional title of Grand Councilor.
entries.literal: On xinyou, Ling Prefecture Feng Hui and Xia Prefecture Li Yiyin were both given the additional title of Grand Councilor.

entries.zh: 右武衛將軍石懿、左武衛將軍石訓並停任。
entries.en: The Right Martial Guard General Shi Yi and the Left Martial Guard General Shi Xun were both suspended from office.
entries.literal: The Right Martial Guard General Shi Yi and the Left Martial Guard General Shi Xun were both suspended from office.

entries.zh: 懿等以八月中秋，享晉五廟，命倡婦宿於齋宮，鴻臚寺劾之，故有是責。
entries.en: Yi and the others, on Mid-Autumn of the eighth month, sacrificed at the five Jin ancestral temples and ordered singing women to lodge in the fasting palace. The Court of Imperial Entertainments impeached them, hence this punishment.
entries.literal: Yi and the others, on Mid-Autumn of the eighth month, sacrificed at the five Jin ancestral temples and ordered singing women to lodge in the fasting palace; the Court of Imperial Entertainments impeached them, hence this punishment.

entries.zh: 癸亥，鎮州武行德、鳳翔趙暉並加檢校太師。
entries.en: On guihai, Wu Xingde of Zhen Prefecture and Zhao Hui of Fengxiang were both given the additional title of Acting Grand Tutor.
entries.literal: On guihai, Zhen Prefecture Wu Xingde and Fengxiang Zhao Hui were both given the additional title of Acting Grand Tutor.

entries.zh: 鄴都、磁、相、邢、洺等州奏，霖雨害稼。
entries.en: Yedu, Ci, Xiang, Xing, Ming, and other prefectures reported that continuous rain had harmed the crops.
entries.literal: Yedu, Ci, Xiang, Xing, Ming, and other prefectures reported that continuous rain harmed the crops.

entries.zh: 西京奏，洛水溢岸。
entries.en: The Western Capital reported that the Luo River had overflowed its banks.
entries.literal: The Western Capital reported that the Luo River overflowed its banks.

entries.zh: 乙丑，晉州王晏、同州張彥赟、邠州侯章、涇州史懿、滄州王景、延州高允權並加檢校太師。
entries.en: On yichou, Wang Yan of Jin Prefecture, Zhang Yanyun of Tong Prefecture, Hou Zhang of Bin Prefecture, Shi Yi of Jing Prefecture, Wang Jing of Cang Prefecture, and Gao Yunquan of Yan Prefecture were all given the additional title of Acting Grand Tutor.
entries.literal: On yichou, Jin Prefecture Wang Yan, Tong Prefecture Zhang Yanyun, Bin Prefecture Hou Zhang, Jing Prefecture Shi Yi, Cang Prefecture Wang Jing, and Yan Prefecture Gao Yunquan were all given the additional title of Acting Grand Tutor.

entries.zh: 冬十月庚午朔，契丹入寇。
entries.en: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day, gengwu, the Khitan invaded.
entries.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day of the month, gengwu, the Khitan invaded.

entries.zh: 是日，定州孫方簡、徐州劉赟並加同平章事，以利州節度使宋延渥為滑州節度使。
entries.en: That day, Sun Fangjian of Ding Prefecture and Liu Yun of Xuzhou were both made Grand Councilors, and the Lizhou military governor Song Yanwo was appointed military governor of Hua Prefecture.
entries.literal: That day, Ding Prefecture Sun Fangjian and Xuzhou Liu Yun were both made Grand Councilors; the Lizhou military governor Song Yanwo was made military governor of Hua Prefecture.

entries.zh: 甲戌，皇弟興元節度使勛加檢校太師。
entries.en: On jiaxu, the emperor's younger brother, the Xingyuan military governor Xun, was given the additional title of Acting Grand Tutor.
entries.literal: On jiaxu, the Emperor's younger brother, the Xingyuan military governor Xun, was given the additional title of Acting Grand Tutor.

entries.zh: 丙子，相州郭謹、貝州王繼宏、邢州薛懷讓並加檢校太尉。
entries.en: On bingzi, Guo Jin of Xiang Prefecture, Wang Jihong of Bei Prefecture, and Xue Huairang of Xing Prefecture were all given the additional title of Acting Grand Marshal.
entries.literal: On bingzi, Xiang Prefecture Guo Jin, Bei Prefecture Wang Jihong, and Xing Prefecture Xue Huairang were all given the additional title of Acting Grand Marshal.

entries.zh: 庚辰，安州楊信、鄧州劉重進加檢校太師，河陽李暉加檢校太傅。
entries.en: On gengchen, Yang Xin of An Prefecture and Liu Chongjin of Deng Prefecture were given the additional title of Acting Grand Tutor, and Li Hui of Heyang was given Acting Grand Mentor.
entries.literal: On gengchen, An Prefecture Yang Xin and Deng Prefecture Liu Chongjin were given the additional title of Acting Grand Tutor; Heyang Li Hui was given Acting Grand Mentor.

entries.zh: 壬午，兩浙錢宏俶加守尚書令，湖南馬希廣加守太尉。
entries.en: On renwu, Qian Hongchu of Liangzhe was given Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Ma Xiguang of Hunan was given Acting Grand Marshal.
entries.literal: On renwu, Liangzhe Qian Hongchu was given Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs; Hunan Ma Xiguang Acting Grand Marshal.

entries.zh: 癸未，監修國史蘇逢吉、史官賈緯以所撰《高祖實錄》二十卷上之。
entries.en: On guiwei, the National History supervisor Su Fengji and the historian Jia Wei presented the twenty-juan Veritable Records of Gaozu they had compiled.
entries.literal: On guiwei, the National History supervisor Su Fengji and the historian Jia Wei presented the twenty-juan Veritable Records of Gaozu they had compiled.

entries.zh: 丙戌，荊南高保融加檢校太師、兼侍中；
entries.en: On bingxu, Gao Baorong of Jingnan was given Acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Palace Attendant;
entries.literal: On bingxu, Jingnan Gao Baorong was given Acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Palace Attendant;

entries.zh: 以殿前都部署、江州防禦使李建為遂州節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使；
entries.en: the Palace Front commander and Jiang Prefecture defender Li Jian was appointed military governor of Suizhou and commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry;
entries.literal: the Palace Front commander and Jiang Prefecture defender Li Jian was made military governor of Suizhou and appointed commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry;

entries.zh: 以奉國左廂都指揮使、永州防禦使王殷為夔州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。
entries.en: and the Fengguo Left Wing commander and Yong Prefecture defender Wang Yin was appointed military governor of Kui Prefecture and commander of the Imperial Guard infantry.
entries.literal: the Fengguo Left Wing commander and Yong Prefecture defender Wang Yin was made military governor of Kui Prefecture and appointed commander of the Imperial Guard infantry.

entries.zh: 契丹陷貝州高老鎮，南至鄴都北境，又西北至南宮、堂陽，殺掠吏民。
entries.en: The Khitan took Gaolao Town in Bei Prefecture, advanced south to the northern border of Yedu, and also northwest to Nangong and Tangyang, killing and plundering officials and people.
entries.literal: The Khitan took Gaolao Town in Bei Prefecture, went south to the northern border of Yedu, and also northwest to Nangong and Tangyang, killing and plundering officials and people.

entries.zh: 數州之地，大被其苦，藩郡守將，閉關自固。
entries.en: Several prefectures suffered greatly. Border commanders and garrison generals closed the passes and held firm on their own.
entries.literal: The lands of several prefectures greatly suffered from them; border commanders and garrison generals closed the passes and held firm on their own.

entries.zh: 遣樞密使郭威率師巡邊，仍令宣徽使王峻參預軍事。
entries.en: The Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei was sent to lead troops on a border patrol, and the Palace Secretariat commissioner Wang Jun was ordered to participate in military affairs.
entries.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei was sent to lead troops on a border patrol, and the Palace Secretariat commissioner Wang Jun was ordered to participate in military affairs.

entries.zh: 庚寅，府州折從阮進封岐國公，豐州郭勛進封虢國公。
entries.en: On gengyin, Zhe Congruan of Fuzhou was advanced to Duke of Qi, and Guo Xun of Feng Prefecture was advanced to Duke of Guo.
entries.literal: On gengyin, Fuzhou Zhe Congruan was advanced to Duke of Qi; Feng Prefecture Guo Xun was advanced to Duke of Guo.

entries.zh: 二月丙子，詔：「諸道州府，所征乾祐元年夏秋苗畝上紐征白米稈草已納外，並放。」
entries.en: In the second month, on bingzi, an edict proclaimed: "In all circuits' prefectures and districts, the summer and autumn field-tax collections of the first year of Qianyou—supplementary levies of white rice and straw per mu already paid—are all remitted."
entries.literal: In the second month, on bingzi, an edict proclaimed: "In all circuits' prefectures and districts, the summer and autumn field-tax collections of the first year of Qianyou—supplementary levies of white rice and straw per mu already paid—are all remitted."

entries.zh: 是日旦，黑霧四塞。
entries.en: At dawn that day black fog filled the four quarters.
entries.literal: At dawn that day, black fog filled the four quarters.

entries.zh: 丁丑夕，大風。
entries.en: On the evening of dingchou there was a great wind.
entries.literal: On the evening of dingchou, a great wind.

entries.zh: 乙酉，以前房州刺史李筠夫為鴻臚卿。
entries.en: On yiyou, the former prefect of Fang Prefecture, Li Junfu, was appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
entries.literal: On yiyou, the former prefect of Fang Prefecture, Li Junfu, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

entries.zh: 戊子，前右監門將軍喬達，及其兄契丹偽命客省使榮等皆棄市。
entries.en: On wuzi, the former Right Gate Guard General Qiao Da, his elder brother Rong—whom the Khitan had falsely appointed Commissioner of the Reception Bureau—and others were all executed in the marketplace.
entries.literal: On wuzi, the former Right Gate Guard General Qiao Da and his elder brother Rong, whom the Khitan had falsely appointed Commissioner of the Reception Bureau, and others were all executed in the marketplace.

entries.zh: 達，李守貞之妹婿也，故皆誅之。
entries.en: Da was married to Li Shouzhen's younger sister; therefore they were all put to death.
entries.literal: Da was the husband of Li Shouzhen's younger sister; therefore they were all put to death.

entries.zh: 庚寅，徐州巡檢使成德欽奏，至峒吾鎮遇淮賊，破之，殺五百人，生擒一百二十人。
entries.en: On gengyin, the Xuzhou inspection commissioner Cheng Deqin memorialized that at Dongwu Town he met Huai rebels, defeated them, killed five hundred men, and captured one hundred twenty alive.
entries.literal: On gengyin, the Xuzhou inspection commissioner Cheng Deqin memorialized: reaching Dongwu Town he met Huai rebels, defeated them, killed five hundred men, and captured alive one hundred twenty.

entries.zh: 戊戌，大雨霖。
entries.en: On wuxu there was heavy continuous rain.
entries.literal: On wuxu, great continuous rain.

entries.zh: 庚子，詔左諫議大夫賈緯等修撰高祖實錄。
entries.en: On gengzi, an edict ordered the Left Remonstrating Counselor Jia Wei and others to compile the Veritable Records of Gaozu.
entries.literal: On gengzi, an edict ordered the Left Remonstrating Counselor Jia Wei and others to compile the Veritable Records of Gaozu.

entries.zh: 乾祐二年春正月乙巳朔，制曰：
entries.en: In spring of the second year of Qianyou, on the first day, yisi, of the first month, an imperial edict proclaimed:
entries.literal: In spring, the first month of the second year of Qianyou, on the first day of the month, yisi, an edict proclaimed:

entries.zh: 二月辛巳，青州奏，郭瓊部署兵士，自海州回至當道。
entries.en: On xinsi in the second month, Qingzhou reported that Guo Qiong's detachment had returned from Haizhou to the province.
entries.literal: In the second month, on day xinsi, Qingzhou memorialized that Guo Qiong had deployed his troops and returned from Haizhou to that circuit.

entries.zh: 甲申，樞密使郭威巡邊回。
entries.en: On jiashen, Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei came back from his border inspection.
entries.literal: On day jiashen, Guo Wei, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, returned from inspecting the borders.

entries.zh: 丁亥，汝州防禦使劉審交卒。
entries.en: On dinghai, Ruzhou defender Liu Shenjiao died.
entries.literal: On day dinghai, Liu Shenjiao, defender of Ruzhou, died.

entries.zh: 乙未，以前安州節度使劉遂凝為左武衛上將軍，以鄜州節度使焦繼勛為右武衛上將軍，以前永興軍節度使趙贊為左驍衛上將軍。
entries.en: On yiwei, former Anzhou commissioner Liu Suining became Left Martial Guard general; Fuzhou commissioner Jiao Jixun became Right Martial Guard general; and former Yongxing commissioner Zhao Zan became Left Valiant Cavalry general.
entries.literal: On day yiwei, Liu Suining, former commissioner of Anzhou, was made General of the Left Martial Guard; Jiao Jixun, commissioner of Fuzhou, was made General of the Right Martial Guard; Zhao Zan, former commissioner of Yongxing, was made General of the Left Valiant Cavalry.

entries.zh: 三月己亥，徐州部送所獲淮南都將李暉等三十三人徇於市，給衫帽放還本土。
entries.en: On jihai in the third month, Xuzhou forwarded thirty-three captured Huainan officers, including Li Hui; after a public parade they were clothed and sent home.
entries.literal: In the third month, on day jihai, Xuzhou sent up the thirty-three Huainan generals captured, including Li Hui; they were paraded through the market, given shirts and caps, and released to their native places.

entries.zh: 是月，鄴都留守高行周、兗州符彥卿、鄆州慕容彥超、西京留守白文珂、鎮州武行德、安州楊信、潞州常思、府州折從阮皆自鎮來朝，嘉慶節故也。
entries.en: That month the regional commanders Gao Xingzhou (Yedu), Fu Yanqing (Yanzhou), Murong Yanchao (Yunzhou), Bai Wenke (western capital), Wu Xingde (Zhenzhou), Yang Xin (Anzhou), Chang Si (Luzhou), and Zhe Congruan (Fuzhou) all arrived at court for the Jiaqing festival.
entries.literal: That month, Gao Xingzhou, regent at Yedu, Fu Yanqing at Yanzhou, Murong Yanchao at Yunzhou, Bai Wenke, regent of the western capital, Wu Xingde at Zhenzhou, Yang Xin at Anzhou, Chang Si at Luzhou, and Zhe Congruan at Fuzhou all came from their posts to court for the Celebration of Good Fortune festival.

entries.zh: 戊午，宴群臣於永福殿，帝初舉樂。
entries.en: On wuwu the emperor banqueted his officials in Yongfu Hall and, for the first time, had music played.
entries.literal: On day wuwu, the emperor feasted the civil and military officials in the Hall of Eternal Felicity; it was the first time he had music performed.

entries.zh: 壬戌，鄴都高行周移鎮鄆州，兗州符彥卿移鎮青州，並加邑封。
entries.en: On renxu, Gao Xingzhou moved from Yedu to Yunzhou and Fu Yanqing from Yanzhou to Qingzhou, each with an enlarged noble fief.
entries.literal: On day renxu, Gao Xingzhou of Yedu was transferred to Yunzhou and Fu Yanqing of Yanzhou to Qingzhou; both received enlarged fiefs.

entries.zh: 甲子，西京留守白文珂、潞州常思、鎮州武行德並進邑封，鄆州慕容彥超移鎮兗州。
entries.en: On jiazi, western-capital regent Bai Wenke, Luzhou's Chang Si, and Zhenzhou's Wu Xingde all gained enlarged fiefs, while Murong Yanchao moved from Yunzhou to Yanzhou.
entries.literal: On day jiazi, Bai Wenke, regent of the western capital, Chang Si of Luzhou, and Wu Xingde of Zhenzhou all received enlarged fiefs; Murong Yanchao of Yunzhou was transferred to Yanzhou.

entries.zh: 夏四月戊辰朔，邢州薛懷讓移鎮同州，相州郭謹、河陽李暉並進邑封。
entries.en: At the summer new moon of the fourth month, Xingzhou's Xue Huairang went to Tongzhou, while Xiangzhou's Guo Jin and Heyang's Li Hui received enlarged fiefs.
entries.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the first day (day wuchen, new moon), Xue Huairang of Xingzhou was transferred to Tongzhou; Guo Jin of Xiangzhou and Li Hui of Heyang all received enlarged fiefs.

entries.zh: 庚午，府州折從阮移鎮鄧州。
entries.en: On gengwu, Fuzhou commissioner Zhe Congruan was reassigned to Dengzhou.
entries.literal: On day gengwu, Zhe Congruan of Fuzhou was transferred to Dengzhou.

entries.zh: 辛未，故深州刺史史萬山贈太傅。
entries.en: On xinwei the late Shenzhou prefect Shi Wanshan was posthumously honored as Grand Mentor.
entries.literal: On day xinwei, the late prefect of Shenzhou, Shi Wanshan, was posthumously made Grand Mentor.

entries.zh: 先是，契丹入邊，萬山城守，郭威遣索萬進率騎七百屯深州。
entries.en: When the Khitan had invaded, Wanshan had defended the city while Guo Wei sent Suo Wanjin with seven hundred cavalry to hold Shenzhou.
entries.literal: Earlier, when the Khitan had entered the borders, Wanshan had held the city; Guo Wei had sent Suo Wanjin to lead seven hundred horsemen to garrison Shenzhou.

entries.zh: 一日，契丹數千騎迫州東門，萬山父子率兵百餘人襲之。
entries.en: One day several thousand Khitan riders pressed the east gate; Wanshan and his son led just over a hundred men in a counterattack.
entries.literal: One day several thousand Khitan horsemen pressed the east gate; Wanshan and his son led a little more than a hundred men to strike them.

entries.zh: 契丹偽退十餘里，而伏兵發，萬山血戰，急請救於萬進，萬進勒兵不出，萬山死之，
entries.en: The Khitan pretended to withdraw ten-odd li, then sprang an ambush; Wanshan fought on until he was covered in blood and begged Wanjin for help, but Wanjin kept his men in camp and Wanshan was killed.
entries.literal: The Khitan feigned a retreat of more than ten li, then ambush troops rose; Wanshan fought until blood flowed, urgently requesting rescue from Wanjin, but Wanjin held his troops and did not go out, and Wanshan died.

entries.zh: 〈（《遼史·世宗紀》：天祿三年殺深州刺史史萬山。）〉
entries.en: (From the History of Liao, Annals of Emperor Shizong: in Tianlu 3 the Khitan killed Shenzhou prefect Shi Wanshan.)
entries.literal: (From the History of Liao, Annals of Emperor Shizong: in the third year of Tianlu the Khitan killed Shenzhou prefect Shi Wanshan.)

entries.zh: 契丹亦解去。
entries.en: The Khitan then withdrew as well.
entries.literal: The Khitan also withdrew and left.

entries.zh: 時論以萬進為罪，故加萬山贈典焉。
entries.en: Public opinion blamed Wanjin, which is why Wanshan received a posthumous enfeoffment.
entries.literal: Contemporary opinion held Wanjin guilty, and therefore Wanshan was given a posthumous honor.

entries.zh: 壬申，華州劉詞移鎮邢州，安州楊信移鎮鄜州，貝州王令溫移鎮安州，並加邑封。
entries.en: On renshen, Liu Ci moved from Huazhou to Xingzhou, Yang Xin from Anzhou to Fuzhou, and Wang Lingwen from Beizhou to Anzhou, each with an enlarged fief.
entries.literal: On day renshen, Liu Ci of Huazhou was transferred to Xingzhou, Yang Xin of Anzhou to Fuzhou, and Wang Lingwen of Beizhou to Anzhou; all received enlarged fiefs.

entries.zh: 以鄜州留後王饒為華州節度使，以其來朝故也。
entries.en: Fuzhou acting commissioner Wang Rao became Huazhou commissioner in reward for attending court.
entries.literal: Wang Rao, acting commissioner of Fuzhou, was made military commissioner of Huazhou because he had come to court.

entries.zh: 丁丑，尚食奉御王紹隱除名，流沙門島，坐匿軍營女口也。
entries.en: On dingchou, imperial-food commissioner Wang Shaoyin was disgraced and exiled to Shamen Island for hiding women taken from army camps.
entries.literal: On day dingchou, Wang Shaoyin, commissioner of imperial food service, was stripped of his name and banished to Shamen Island for concealing women from military camps.

entries.zh: 辛巳，以宣徽北院使吳虔裕為鄭州防禦使。
entries.en: On xinsi, northern secretariat commissioner Wu Qianyu was appointed defender of Zhengzhou.
entries.literal: On day xinsi, Wu Qianyu, commissioner of the northern bureau of the palace secretariat, was made defender of Zhengzhou.

entries.zh: 時樞密使楊邠上章乞解樞機，帝命中使諭之曰：「樞機之職，舍卿用誰？
entries.en: Bureau commissioner Yang Bin asked to step down; the emperor sent a palace envoy to say, "Who but you could hold this post?
entries.literal: At the time Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Yang Bin submitted a memorial requesting to be relieved of the bureau. The emperor ordered a palace envoy to instruct him, saying: "The bureau post—apart from you, whom should We employ?

entries.zh: 忽有此章，莫有人離間否？」
entries.en: This sudden memorial—has someone turned you against us?"
entries.literal: To have this memorial so suddenly—has someone sown discord?"

entries.zh: 虔裕在傍揚言曰：「樞密重地，難以久處，俾後來者叠居，相公辭讓是也。」
entries.en: Wu Qianyu, standing nearby, called out, "The bureau is too heavy to keep for long; better to let successors take turns—your resignation is the right move."
entries.literal: Qianyu, standing beside him, spoke out loudly: "The bureau is a weighty post and hard to hold for long; let those who come later take turns in succession—the minister's resignation is right."

entries.zh: 中使還具奏，帝不悅，故有是命。
entries.en: When the envoy reported this, the emperor was displeased and therefore sent Qianyu away to Zhengzhou.
entries.literal: The envoy returned and reported in full; the emperor was displeased, and therefore there was this appointment.

entries.zh: 壬午，以樞密使郭威鄴都留守，依前樞密使。
entries.en: On renwu, bureau commissioner Guo Wei became Yedu regent while keeping his bureau title.
entries.literal: On day renwu, Guo Wei, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made regent at Yedu while retaining the bureau post.

entries.zh: 詔河北諸州，應兵甲、錢帛、糧草一稟郭威處分。
entries.en: An edict placed all armor, cash, silk, and grain of the Hebei prefectures under Guo Wei's authority.
entries.literal: An edict ordered that all the prefectures north of the Yellow River, as to armor, weapons, cash, silks, and grain, should be entirely at Guo Wei's disposal.

entries.zh: 癸未，府州永安軍額宜停，命降為團練州。
entries.en: On guimao, Fuzhou's Yong'an army designation was abolished and the prefecture downgraded to a training command.
entries.literal: On day guimao, the designation of Yong'an army at Fuzhou was to be discontinued and the prefecture reduced to a training command.

entries.zh: 戊子，翰林學士承旨、戶部尚書王仁裕罷職，守兵部尚書。
entries.en: On wuzi, Hanlin ex officio and revenue minister Wang Renyu was demoted to war minister.
entries.literal: On day wuzi, Wang Renyu, Hanlin academician ex officio and Minister of Revenue, was removed from office and kept on as Minister of War.

entries.zh: 左千牛上將軍張瓘卒。
entries.en: Left Palace Guard general Zhang Guan died.
entries.literal: Zhang Guan, General of the Left Palace Guard, died.

entries.zh: 庚寅，以西南面水陸轉運使、尚書工部侍郎李穀為陳州刺史。
entries.en: On gengyin, southwestern transport commissioner and vice minister of works Li Gu became Chenzhou prefect.
entries.literal: On day gengyin, Li Gu, transport commissioner for the southwestern land and water routes and Vice Minister of Works, was made prefect of Chenzhou.

entries.zh: 左金吾上將軍致仕馬萬卒。
entries.en: Retired Left Golden Guard general Ma Wan died.
entries.literal: Ma Wan, retired General of the Left Golden Guard, died.

entries.zh: 甲午，以前華州節度使安審信為左衛上將軍，以前潞州節度使張從恩為右衛上將軍。
entries.en: On jiawu, former Huazhou commissioner An Shenxin became Left Imperial Guard general and former Luzhou commissioner Zhang Cong'en Right Imperial Guard general.
entries.literal: On day jiawu, An Shenxin, former commissioner of Huazhou, was made General of the Left Imperial Guard; Zhang Cong'en, former commissioner of Luzhou, was made General of the Right Imperial Guard.

entries.zh: 十一月甲子朔，日有食之。
entries.en: The eleventh-month new moon brought a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day (day jiazi, new moon), there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 乙丑，永州唐將軍祠贈太保，從湖南請也。
entries.en: On yichou Yongzhou's General Tang shrine received a posthumous Grand Guardian title at Hunan's request.
entries.literal: On day yichou, the shrine of General Tang of Yongzhou was posthumously given Grand Guardian, in accordance with a request from Hunan.

entries.zh: 己巳，日南至，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。
entries.en: On jisi, the winter solstice, the emperor took congratulations in Chongyuan Hall with full ceremonial guard.
entries.literal: On day jisi, the winter solstice; the emperor attended the Chongyuan Hall and received congratulatory audience; guards and insignia followed the prescribed forms.

entries.zh: 辛未，詔侍衛步軍都指揮使王殷將兵屯澶州。
entries.en: On xinwei an edict sent palace-guard foot commander Wang Yin to encamp at Chanzhou.
entries.literal: On day xinwei, an edict ordered Wang Yin, overall commander of the palace guard foot soldiers, to lead troops to garrison at Chanzhou.

entries.zh: 丙子，誅樞密使楊邠、侍衛都指揮使史宏肇、三司使王章，夷其族。
entries.en: On bingzi, bureau commissioner Yang Bin, guard commander Shi Hongzhao, and three-departments commissioner Wang Zhang were put to death and their families wiped out.
entries.literal: On day bingzi, the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Yang Bin, overall commander of the guard Shi Hongzhao, and commissioner of the three departments Wang Zhang were executed and their clans exterminated.

entries.zh: 是日平旦，甲士數十人由廣政殿出，至東廡下，害邠等於閣內，死於亂刃之下。
entries.en: At dawn that day dozens of soldiers left Guangzheng Hall for the east wing and cut down Bin and his colleagues in a side room.
entries.literal: That day at dawn, several tens of armored soldiers came out from the Guangzheng Hall to the eastern veranda and killed Bin and the others inside the side chamber, dying under a chaos of blades.

entries.zh: 又誅宏肇弟小底軍都虞候宏朗、如京使甄彥奇、內常侍辛從審、楊邠子比部員外郎廷侃、右衛將軍廷偉、右贊善大夫廷倚、王章侄右領衛將軍旻、子婿戶部員外郎張貽肅、樞密院副承宣郭颙、控鶴都虞候高進、侍衛都承局荊南金、三司都勾官柴訓等。
entries.en: The purge also took Hongzhao's brother Honglang, capital envoy Zhen Yanqi, attendant Xin Congshen, Yang Bin's sons Tingkan, Tingwei, and Tingyi, Wang Zhang's nephew Min and son-in-law Zhang Yisu, bureau deputy herald Guo Ying, crane-guard commander Gao Jin, guard staff officer Jingnan Jin, and three-departments auditor Chai Xun, among others.
entries.literal: Also executed were Hongzhao's younger brother Honglang, junior army commander of the inner guard; Zhen Yanqi, envoy to the capital; inner attendant Xin Congshen; Yang Bin's son Tingkan, outer court director of the ministry of rites; right guard generals Tingwei and Tingyi, right aide to the heir apparent; Wang Zhang's nephew Min, right guard general; son-in-law Zhang Yisu, outer director of the ministry of revenue; Guo Ying, deputy herald of the bureau; Gao Jin, commander of the crane-control guard; Jingnan Jin of the guard staff bureau; Chai Xun, chief auditor of the three departments, and others.

entries.zh: 分兵收捕邠等家屬及部曲傔從，盡戮之。
entries.en: Separate detachments hunted down their kin, retainers, and clients and killed them all.
entries.literal: Troops were sent separately to seize the families, retainers, and followers of Bin and the others and all were slaughtered.

entries.zh: 少頃，樞密承旨聶文進急召宰臣百僚，班於崇元殿，庭宣曰：「楊邠、史宏肇、王章等同謀叛逆，欲危宗社，並斬之，與卿等同慶。」
entries.en: Moments later bureau herald Nie Wenjin assembled the ministers in Chongyuan Hall and announced from the courtyard, "Yang Bin, Shi Hongzhao, and Wang Zhang had plotted treason, had been executed, and that all should rejoice."
entries.literal: Shortly after, bureau herald Nie Wenjin urgently summoned the chief ministers and the hundred officials to line up in the Chongyuan Hall; in the courtyard he proclaimed: "Yang Bin, Shi Hongzhao, Wang Zhang, and others together plotted rebellion and wished to endanger the altars of state; all have been beheaded—rejoice with Us.

entries.zh: 班退，召諸軍將校至萬歲殿，帝親諭史宏肇等欲謀逆亂之狀，且言：「宏肇等欺朕年幼，專權擅命，使汝輩常懷憂恐，自此朕自與汝等為主，必無橫憂也。」
entries.en: After dismissal he gathered commanders in Wansui Hall, accused Hongzhao's party of treason, and said, "They bullied a young emperor, seized power, and kept you in fear—from now on I rule for you myself and you need not dread sudden ruin."
entries.literal: When the audience withdrew, military commanders were summoned to the Hall of Ten Thousand Years; the emperor personally explained the signs of Hongzhao and the others' intended rebellion, and said: "Hongzhao and the others deceived Us while We were young, monopolized authority and issued orders on their own, so that you constantly lived in fear; from now on We Ourselves will be master for you—there will certainly be no sudden calamity."

entries.zh: 諸軍將校拜謝而退。
entries.en: The commanders bowed and left.
entries.literal: The military commanders bowed in thanks and withdrew.

entries.zh: 召前任節度使、刺史、統軍等上殿諭之。
entries.en: Former commissioners, prefects, and army inspectors were called in and addressed.
entries.literal: Former commissioners, prefects, and army supervisors were summoned to the hall and instructed.

entries.zh: 帝遣軍士守捉宮城諸門，比近日旰，朝臣步出宮門而去。
entries.en: Troops sealed the palace gates; courtiers did not leave until near dusk, far later than usual.
entries.literal: The emperor sent soldiers to guard all the gates of the palace city; compared with recent days it was already dusk when courtiers walked out through the palace gates.

entries.zh: 是日晴霽無雲，而昏霧濛濛，有如微雨，人情惴恐。
entries.en: Though the sky was clear, a dull haze like drizzle hung over the city and fear spread among the people.
entries.literal: That day was clear without clouds, yet a dim mist hung hazy as if in light rain, and people's hearts were fearful.

entries.zh: 日將午，載楊邠等十餘屍，分暴於南北市。
entries.en: Near noon a dozen-odd bodies, including Yang Bin's, were paraded and displayed in both markets.
entries.literal: As the sun neared noon, more than ten corpses including Yang Bin's were loaded and publicly exposed in the northern and southern markets.

entries.zh: 是日，帝遣腹心賫密詔往澶州、鄴都，令澶州節度使李洪義誅侍衛步軍都指揮使王殷，令鄴都屯駐護聖左廂都指揮使郭崇、奉國左廂都指揮使曹英害樞密使郭威及宣徽使王峻。
entries.en: That day he sent a secret edict to Chanzhou and Yedu ordering Li Hongyi to kill Wang Yin and ordering Guo Chong and Cao Ying to murder Guo Wei and Wang Jun.
entries.literal: That day the emperor sent a trusted agent bearing a secret edict to Chanzhou and Yedu, ordering Chanzhou commissioner Li Hongyi to kill foot-commander Wang Yin, and ordering Guo Chong, commander of the left wing of the guard-for-the-sacred, and Cao Ying, commander of the left wing of the nation-supporting army, to kill bureau commissioner Guo Wei and palace commissioner Wang Jun.

entries.zh: 急詔鄆州高行周、青州符彥卿、永興郭從義、兗州慕容彥超、同州薛懷讓、鄭州吳虔裕、陳州李穀等赴闕。
entries.en: Emergency orders called Gao Xingzhou, Fu Yanqing, Guo Congyi, Murong Yanchao, Xue Huairang, Wu Qianyu, Li Gu, and others to the capital.
entries.literal: Urgent edicts summoned Gao Xingzhou of Yunzhou, Fu Yanqing of Qingzhou, Guo Congyi of Yongxing, Murong Yanchao of Yanzhou, Xue Huairang of Tongzhou, Wu Qianyu of Zhengzhou, Li Gu of Chenzhou, and others to court.

entries.zh: 以宰臣蘇逢吉權知樞密院事，前青州劉銖權知開封府事，侍衛馬軍都指揮使李洪建判侍衛司事，內客省使閻晉卿權侍衛馬軍都指揮使。
entries.en: Su Fengji took acting charge of the bureau, former Qingzhou commissioner Liu Zhu acting Kaifeng mayor, guard horse commander Li Hongjian managing guard affairs, and inner-service commissioner Yan Jinqing acting horse commander.
entries.literal: The chief minister Su Fengji was given acting authority over the bureau; Liu Zhu of former Qingzhou was given acting authority over Kaifeng; Li Hongjian, horse-commander of the guard, was assigned to manage guard affairs; inner-service commissioner Yan Jinqing was made acting horse-commander of the guard.

entries.zh: 丁丑，澶州節度使李洪義受得密詔，知事不克，乃引使人見王殷。
entries.en: On dingchou, Chanzhou commissioner Li Hongyi received the secret edict, saw the plot would fail, and brought the envoy to Wang Yin.
entries.literal: On day dingchou, Li Hongyi, commissioner of Chanzhou, received the secret edict and knew the affair could not succeed; he therefore led the envoy to see Wang Yin.

entries.zh: 殷與洪義遣本州副使陳光穗賫所受密詔，馳至鄴都。
entries.en: Yin and Hongyi sent vice commissioner Chen Guangsu with the edict at full speed to Yedu.
entries.literal: Yin and Hongyi sent the prefectural vice commissioner Chen Guangsu bearing the secret edict they had received, galloping to Yedu.

entries.zh: 〈（《宋史》：少帝遣供奉官孟業賫密詔，令洪義殺王殷。
entries.en: (From the History of Song: the young emperor sent tribute officer Meng Ye with a secret edict for Hongyi to kill Wang Yin.
entries.literal: (From the History of Song: the young emperor sent the tribute officer Meng Ye bearing a secret edict ordering Hongyi to kill Wang Yin.

entries.zh: 洪義素怯懦，慮殷覺，遷延不敢發，遽引業見殷。
entries.en: Hongyi was by nature cowardly, feared discovery, hesitated, then abruptly presented Ye to Yin.
entries.literal: Hongyi had always been timid; fearing Yin would detect it, he delayed and did not dare act, but abruptly led Ye to see Yin.

entries.zh: 殷乃錮業，送密詔於周祖。）〉
entries.en: Yin imprisoned Ye and forwarded the secret edict to the Zhou founder.)〉
entries.literal: Yin then imprisoned Ye and sent the secret edict to the Zhou founder.)〉

entries.zh: 郭威得之，即召王峻、郭崇、曹英及諸軍將校，至牙署視詔，兼告楊、史諸公冤枉之狀，且曰：「汝等當奉行詔旨，斷予首以報天子，自取功名。」
entries.en: Guo Wei summoned Wang Jun, Guo Chong, Cao Ying, and his commanders, showed them the edict, described how Yang Bin and Shi Hongzhao had been wronged, and said, "Obey the edict—cut off my head for the emperor and win your reward."
entries.literal: When Guo Wei received it, he immediately summoned Wang Jun, Guo Chong, Cao Ying, and the military commanders to the headquarters office to view the edict, and also told them of the wrongful deaths of Yang and Shi and the others, saying: "You should carry out the edict's command, cut off Our head to report to the Son of Heaven, and take merit for yourselves."

entries.zh: 郭崇等與諸將校前曰：「此事必非聖意，即是李業等竊發，假如此輩便握權柄，國得安乎！
entries.en: Guo Chong and the others stepped forward: "This cannot be the emperor's will—it must be Li Ye's clique. If they hold power, how can the realm be safe?
entries.literal: Guo Chong and the commanders stepped forward and said: "This affair is certainly not the sage emperor's intent; it must be Li Ye and others acting in secret. If such men were to grasp power, could the state be secure!

entries.zh: 事可陳論，何須自棄，致千載之下被此惡名。
entries.en: The case can be argued—why destroy yourselves and earn infamy for ages?
entries.literal: The matter can be explained; why must you abandon yourselves and leave a foul name for a thousand years below?

entries.zh: 崇等願從公入朝，面自洗雪。」
entries.en: Chong and the others asked to follow him to court and clear their names in person."
entries.literal: Chong and the others wish to follow the lord into court and personally clear themselves."

entries.zh: 於是將校等請威入朝，以除君側之惡，共安天下。
entries.en: The commanders then urged Wei to march on the capital, purge the emperor's evil counselors, and settle the realm.
entries.literal: Thereupon the commanders asked Wei to enter court to remove evil beside the ruler and together pacify the realm.

entries.zh: 〈（《東都事略》：漢隱帝遣使害太祖，魏仁浦曰：「公有大功於朝廷，握強兵，臨重鎮，以讒見疑，豈可坐而待斃！」
entries.en: (From the Summary of Affairs in the Eastern Capital: Emperor Yin sent agents to kill Guo Wei. Wei Renpu said, "You have great service, command a powerful army, and hold a key post—slandered and suspected, how can you sit and die?"
entries.literal: (From the Summary of Affairs in the Eastern Capital: Emperor Yin of Han sent envoys to kill the founding ancestor. Wei Renpu said: "You have great merit toward the court, hold a strong army, and face a weighty post; because of slander you are suspected—how can you sit and await death!"

entries.zh: 教以易其語，雲誅將士，以激怒眾心。
entries.en: He told them to alter the wording to call for executing the soldiers and stir popular anger.
entries.literal: He taught them to change the wording to say execute the officers, in order to inflame popular feeling.

entries.zh: 太祖納其言。）〉
entries.en: Guo Wei took his advice.)〉
entries.literal: The founding ancestor accepted his advice.)〉

entries.zh: 翌日，郭威以眾南行。
entries.en: The next day Guo Wei marched south.
entries.literal: The next day, Guo Wei led his host south.

entries.zh: 戊寅，鄴兵至澶州。
entries.en: On wuyin the Yedu force reached Chanzhou.
entries.literal: On day wuyin, the Yedu army reached Chanzhou.

entries.zh: 庚辰，至滑州，節度使宋延渥開門迎降。
entries.en: On gengchen they reached Huazhou; commissioner Song Yanwo opened the gates in surrender.
entries.literal: On day gengchen, they reached Huazhou; commissioner Song Yanwo opened the gates and surrendered.

entries.zh: 是日，詔前開封尹侯益、前鄜州節度使張彥超、權侍衛馬軍都指揮使閻晉卿、鄭州防禦使吳虔裕等，率禁軍赴澶州守捉。
entries.en: That day an edict sent former Kaifeng mayor Hou Yi, former Fuzhou commissioner Zhang Yanchao, acting guard horse commander Yan Jinqing, Zhengzhou defender Wu Qianyu, and others with the palace guard to hold Chanzhou.
entries.literal: That day, an edict ordered former Kaifeng mayor Hou Yi, former Fuzhou commissioner Zhang Yanchao, acting guard horse commander Yan Jinqing, Zhengzhou defender Wu Qianyu, and others to lead the palace guard to Chanzhou to intercept.

entries.zh: 辛巳，帝之小豎嵒脫自北回。
entries.en: The emperor's young attendant Yan Tuo returned from the north.
entries.literal: The emperor's young attendant Yan Tuo returned from the north.

entries.zh: 先是，帝遣嵒脫偵鄴軍所至，為遊騎所獲，郭威即遣回，因令附奏赴闕之意，仍以密奏置嵒脫衣領中。
entries.en: The emperor had sent Yan Tuo to scout the Yedu army; scouts seized him, but Guo Wei sent him back with a collar-hidden memorial stating his intent to come to court.
